title: Find the Field of Comfort, Goodness, Happiness, Success & Ability
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa
lillahi 'l-hamd! As-salaatu wa salaamu `alayka yaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen. As-salaamu `alaykum
yaa Sahib az-Zamaan! As-salaamu `alaykum yaa `ibaadAllah as-saaliheen. Yaa RijaalAllah! (…) Sultan alAwliya (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
As-salaamu `alaykum, yaa `ibaadAllah. As-salaamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.
(...)
O People! We are in need of rahmatullah, heavenly mercy, because Mankind has reached a point where they
are asking to finish off everyone from the other side. That is the most important target for Shaytan. He is
asking to bring down all of Mankind as from the time that Allah Almighty was ordering the angels to make
sajda, to bow to Adam (a), Shaytan was the first one to say, "I am not bowing."
From that time until today, Allah Almighty has ordered the angels, "Keep that one from the Divine Presence;
I don't like to see him or those from Mankind who will follow him." And Allah Almighty is not looking at
them, but He is looking at heavenly mercy, saying, "I don't like to see those people who are following Shaytan

and not My holy orders that I send them through My prophets." (Mawlana Shaykh stands) He Almighty, all
Glory and Majesty is for Him only! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! Look at what is happening now to all Mankind, which may be five billion or more, and yet you can't
find two persons to love, help or support each other. Shaytan is ordering them, "Don't obey." Why? Shaytan
was thrown away, taken away, kicked away from the Divine Presence, and he is asking for all of Mankind to
also be kicked away. What is happening now is because people are all following Shaytan and leaving the
guidance of their Lord, Allah Almighty. There is so much bad news every day, and as long as Mankind is with
Shaytan and leaving their Lord's ways, what is coming will be worse than before. Today is worse than
yesterday, and tomorrow is going to be worse than today.
O Mankind! You can’t find a way to take you from bad conditions, to save you from crisis and bad actions,
battles and killings that Mankind invented through technology! All Mankind is now supporting technology
and through that a curse is raining on them. Today is better than tomorrow; yesterday was better than today.
So many things will come, until four out of five people will be taken away. Allah! Tawbah, yaa Rabbee! We are
asking for forgiveness!
The Seal of Prophets (s) gave us good tidings of when Jesus Christ (a) will come on Earth to take away
technology. If people would choose to leave technology on their own, they would find the field of comfort,
goodness, happiness, success, and ability, but they are not leaving it; they are stubborn like goats, refusing to
leave their technology, and that is leading them to a terrible end, when billions will be killed through
technology. There will come a poison and those who breathe it will fall down dead. It will not affect believers,
but the others will be taken away. Yaa Rabbee!
O People! Come and listen to what your Lord is ordering you. In particular, I am giving my declaration to
Muslims and to Muslim territories: if they are not keeping the holy orders of the Lord of Heavens, for every
non-Muslim being whipped, there will be seven whippings for the Muslim world! If one punishment is
coming for the non-Muslim world, seven times more will come on the Muslims because they left the way of
Heavens and for that they will come to a terrible end. May Allah forgive us!
O People! You may live one-hundred years or more, but you will not become young again! Our bodies and
organs are getting older. Sometimes men ask, "O my Lord! Take my soul because my physical being is not

giving me pleasure any longer." Don't think that when you reach seventy, eighty, or ninety years old you will
take the same pleasure as when you were fifteen, twenty, twenty-five, or forty years old; pleasure decreases.
Therefore, people are trying to reach a new one, but you can't renew your body as it is finished; however, men
ask for a new body to make them happy.
Now people are drunk and think they are getting younger, that they are renewing themselves. That can't be as
you are finished. You think you will to be able to do this with your physical being, but it is better to try to
establish a good life here and Hereafter.
O People! Try to give more time in service of your Lord, because we were created for it, but the whole world
lost this key: first the Muslim world, then Christianity and the Jewish faith. That command is for everyone,
and if anyone says, “That shaykh is not speaking the truth,” they will die tonight, finished! Keep yourself for
your Lord’s servanthood and don’t run after dunya; it is your purpose and honor to be your Lord’s servant.
O Allah! Send us a powerful one to teach us how to be servants of our Lord. If not, cursing and badness,
darkness, hells and black holes will take them away to unknown territories. May Allah forgive us. It is your
chance now to be for Allah Almighty, not to be for Shaytan! Astaghfirullah, may Allah forgive us.
Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah. Yaa Rabbee! Anta Mawlana fansurna `alal qawmi ‘l-kafireen. Bi
hurmati 'l-habeeb, bi hurmati 'l-Fatihah.
